node.title: Re^5: PAR::Packer generated EXE that was detected as a trojan...
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
... although I've not identified specifically where yet. ... there may be malicious versions in the wild that insert malicious code into your compiled perl executables.

Sorry, but without specifics, this smells like FUD. Most people are likely to get their [mod://PAR::Packer] [https://www.cpan.org/modules/by-module/PAR/|from CPAN]. [https://www.cpan.org/MIRRORED.BY|The list of mirrors] can be parsed by e.g. [mod://CPAN::Mirrors]. If something were to be found there, then action would need to be taken.
